declaration-property-value-disallowed-li.message: AR-05 / SC 2.4.7: removing the focus outline removes the only signal a keyboard user has about where they are. If you need a different indicator, draw it and keep the outline transparent-but-present — do not set it to none. This rule cannot be disabled in AAL (PRD §10.5).

color-no-hex.message: AR-07 / AR-08: hard-coded colours bypass the token system, and therefore bypass the contrast gate, the dark and high-contrast themes, and forced-colors support. Use a semantic token: var(--aal-color-...). See PRD §10.2.

declaration-no-important.message: !important in component styles defeats consumer theming and usually hides a specificity problem. The only legitimate use in AAL is the Tier 4 sealed invariants, which are GENERATED into libs/tokens/src/styles/tokens.css (ignored by this config) — see PRD §10.2.

unit-disallowed-list.message: AR-18 / SC 1.4.4: px font sizes and spacing silently defeat the user's own browser text-size setting. Use rem. Exempt: hairline borders, outlines, and the 24px minimum target size, which must NOT scale down with the root font (AR-09).
